mergewith.subtemplate:
<!-- Birth Death Sequential Sampling model--> <BDSSModel spec="bdtree.likelihood.BirthDeathSequentialSampling" id="BDSS.t:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)"> <birthRate id="birthRateBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0"/> <deathRate id="deathRateBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="1.0"/> <rho id="rhoBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="RealScalarParam" domain="UnitInterval" value="0.1"/> <psi id="psiBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="RealScalarParam" domain="NonNegativeReal" value="0.001"/> </BDSSModel>
<distribution id="birthRatePriorBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Exponential" param="@birthRateBDSS.t:$(n)"> <mean spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.5" estimate="false"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="deathRatePriorBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Exponential" param="@deathRateBDSS.t:$(n)"> <mean spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate="false"/> </distribution>
<distribution id="rhoPriorBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Exponential" param="@rhoBDSS.t:$(n)"> <mean spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.1" estimate="false"/> </distribution> <distribution id="psiPriorBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.distribution.Exponential" param="@psiBDSS.t:$(n)"> <mean spec="RealScalarParam" domain="PositiveReal" value="0.01" estimate="false"/> </distribution>
<operator id="BirthRateScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@birthRateBDSS.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="DeathRateScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@deathRateBDSS.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="RhoScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@rhoBDSS.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="PsiScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="beast.base.spec.inference.operator.ScaleOperator" parameter="@psiBDSS.t:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.75" weight="10.0"/>
<!-- operators for BDSS trees --> <operator id="TreeScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="ScaleOperator" scaleFactor="0.5" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="TreeRootScalerBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="ScaleOperator" rootOnly="true" scaleFactor="0.5" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="TreeUniformOperatorBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="Uniform" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="20.0"/> <operator id="TreeSubtreeSlideBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="SubtreeSlide" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="15.0"/> <operator id="TreeNarrow.BDSS.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="15.0"/> <operator id="TreeWideBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="Exchange" isNarrow="false" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="TreeWilsonBaldingBDSS.t:$(n)" spec="WilsonBalding" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="5.0"/>
prior on birthRateBDSS.t:$(n) prior on deathRateBDSS.t:$(n) prior on rhoBDSS.t:$(n) prior on psiBDSS.t:$(n)
